name: job.navigate
description: DECISION LAYER. Chooses the next action in an application run. state = the observed workflow state (fresh form snapshot hash, ledger row, evidence inventory, candidate-set provenance). Jev selects from a fixed action set and never executes; a separate dispatcher runs only allowlisted reversible actions. Any irreversible or outward step routes to a human regardless of score.

next_action.instructions: Select exactly one next action from the fixed set

criteria.fill_next_field: the next field has a provenance-cleared candidate and the form state is fresh
criteria.prepare_tailored_packet: the job is qualified and no role-bound packet exists yet
criteria.fetch_verified_recipient: outreach is planned and the recipient identity is not yet verified
criteria.needs_owner_answer: a required value cannot be answered from evidence and only Mike can decide
criteria.stop_before_submit: every reversible step is complete; a human must take the irreversible one
criteria.escalate_blocker: an evidence contradiction, duplicate risk or unavailable tool makes all other actions unsafe
criteria.no_change_report_blocked: a required precondition failed; report BLOCKED and stop

state_observable.instructions: Is the current workflow state actually observed from fresh evidence, such as a current form read-back or a timestamped file hash, rather than assumed from a prior run, a cache, or a narrative claim?

irreversible_step.instructions: Does the next action cross an irreversible or outward boundary: submitting an application, sending a message, publishing, deleting, paying, accepting a legal term, changing an account, or editing a public profile?

evidence_sufficiency.instructions: How much verified evidence backs the chosen action
criteria: no evidence, or only narrative assertion
one dated source, unverified against the live target
two independent sources plus a recorded hash or receipt reference

rules.reason: next step is irreversible or outward: must become stop_before_submit and be taken by a human (first-five pilot rule)
state was not observed from fresh evidence; fail closed rather than act on an assumed state
not enough evidence to justify any action
only Mike can answer this; stop and present the exact question

notes: Division of labour, by RIG law 'deterministic before agentic': code holds the irreversible-action allowlist and the fresh-state hash check, because both are enumerable and testable. Jev supplies judgement only where code cannot: what the state means and which action the evidence supports. The navigator never performs the action. A choice answer is a routing decision and carries no confidence floor guarantee for the action itself; the action still re-checks its own preconditions in the dispatcher. Advisory while calibrated:false.
